-- Select application progress list for paginated operation and user screens. SELECT ap.id AS progress_id, ap.matching_case_id, ap.announcement_id, ap.member_user_id, ap.current_step_id, ap.status_code, ap.receipt_no, ap.receipt_date, ap.result_code, ap.result_note, ap.result_date, ap.received_amount, ap.created_at, ap.updated_at FROM application_progresses ap
ORDER BY ap.created_at DESC, ap.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count application progress rows for paginated list. SELECT count(1) FROM application_progresses ap

-- Select application progress details by primary key. SELECT ap.id AS progress_id, ap.matching_case_id, ap.announcement_id, ap.member_user_id, ap.current_step_id, ap.status_code, ap.receipt_no, ap.receipt_date, ap.result_code, ap.result_note, ap.result_date, ap.received_amount, ap.created_at, ap.updated_at FROM application_progresses ap WHERE ap.id = #{progressId}

-- Select application progress by matching case unique key. SELECT ap.id AS progress_id, ap.matching_case_id, ap.announcement_id, ap.member_user_id, ap.current_step_id, ap.status_code, ap.receipt_no, ap.receipt_date, ap.result_code, ap.result_note, ap.result_date, ap.received_amount, ap.created_at, ap.updated_at FROM application_progresses ap WHERE ap.matching_case_id = #{matchingCaseId}

-- Select matching case fields required for progress creation. SELECT mc.id AS matching_case_id, mc.announcement_id, mc.member_user_id, mc.status_code FROM matching_cases mc WHERE mc.id = #{matchingCaseId}

-- Select active announcement progress steps ordered for initialization. SELECT aps.id AS step_id, aps.step_order, aps.step_name, aps.is_active FROM announcement_progress_steps aps WHERE aps.announcement_id = #{announcementId} AND aps.is_active = true ORDER BY aps.step_order ASC, aps.id ASC

-- Select initialized step states for a progress. SELECT ass.id AS step_state_id, ass.progress_id, ass.step_id, aps.step_order, aps.step_name, ass.status_code, ass.started_at, ass.completed_at FROM application_step_states ass INNER JOIN announcement_progress_steps aps ON aps.id = ass.step_id WHERE ass.progress_id = #{progressId} ORDER BY aps.step_order ASC, aps.id ASC

-- Select one initialized step state. SELECT ass.id AS step_state_id, ass.progress_id, ass.step_id, aps.step_order, aps.step_name, ass.status_code, ass.started_at, ass.completed_at FROM application_step_states ass INNER JOIN announcement_progress_steps aps ON aps.id = ass.step_id WHERE ass.progress_id = #{progressId} AND ass.step_id = #{stepId}

-- Select progress checklist states with document metadata. SELECT asc1.id AS checklist_id, asc1.progress_id, asd.id AS step_document_id, asd.step_id, asd.document_type_code, asd.is_required, COALESCE(asc1.is_checked, false) AS is_checked, asc1.checked_at, asc1.checked_by FROM application_progresses ap INNER JOIN announcement_progress_steps aps ON aps.announcement_id = ap.announcement_id INNER JOIN announcement_step_documents asd ON asd.step_id = aps.id LEFT JOIN application_step_checklists asc1 ON asc1.progress_id = ap.id AND asc1.step_document_id = asd.id WHERE ap.id = #{progressId} ORDER BY aps.step_order ASC, asd.sort_order ASC, asd.id ASC

-- Select configured button for a progress step action. SELECT asb.step_id, asb.button_code, asb.button_label, asb.button_action_code, asb.next_step_id, asb.sort_order FROM announcement_step_buttons asb WHERE asb.step_id = #{stepId} AND asb.button_code = #{buttonCode}

-- Select configured progress step buttons for display. SELECT asb.step_id, asb.button_code, asb.button_label, asb.button_action_code, asb.next_step_id, asb.sort_order FROM application_progresses ap INNER JOIN announcement_progress_steps aps ON aps.announcement_id = ap.announcement_id INNER JOIN announcement_step_buttons asb ON asb.step_id = aps.id WHERE ap.id = #{progressId} AND aps.is_active = true ORDER BY aps.step_order ASC, asb.sort_order ASC, asb.id ASC

-- Select next active step when a button does not explicitly define one. SELECT aps.id FROM announcement_progress_steps aps WHERE aps.announcement_id = #{announcementId} AND aps.is_active = true AND aps.step_order > #{stepOrder} ORDER BY aps.step_order ASC, aps.id ASC LIMIT 1

-- Count required step documents that are not checked for the progress. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_step_documents asd LEFT JOIN application_step_checklists asc1 ON asc1.step_document_id = asd.id AND asc1.progress_id = #{progressId} WHERE asd.step_id = #{stepId} AND asd.is_required = true AND COALESCE(asc1.is_checked, false) = false
mapper.insert: -- Insert application progress from one MATCHED matching case. INSERT INTO application_progresses ( id, matching_case_id, announcement_id, member_user_id, current_step_id, status_code, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{progressId}, #{matchingCaseId}, #{announcementId}, #{memberUserId}, #{currentStepId}, 'READY', #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )

-- Insert initialized step state for a progress. INSERT INTO application_step_states ( id, progress_id, step_id, status_code, started_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{stepStateId}, #{progressId}, #{stepId}, #{statusCode}, CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'READY' THEN now() ELSE NULL END, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Mark matching case as progressed after application progress creation. UPDATE matching_cases SET status_code = 'PROGRESSED', updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{matchingCaseId} AND status_code = 'MATCHED'

-- Update one progress step state. UPDATE application_step_states SET status_code = #{statusCode}, started_at = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} IN ('READY', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND started_at IS NULL THEN now() ELSE started_at END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'COMPLETED' THEN now() ELSE completed_at END, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE progress_id = #{progressId} AND step_id = #{stepId}

-- Update current step pointer and progress status. UPDATE application_progresses SET current_step_id = #{currentStepId,jdbcType=OTHER}, status_code = #{statusCode}, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{progressId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert sanitized progress action log without raw personal input. INSERT INTO application_action_logs ( progress_id, step_id, actor_user_id, action_code, button_code, input_json ) VALUES ( #{progressId}, #{stepId}, #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{buttonCode}, CAST(#{inputJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )

-- Upsert one progress checklist state. INSERT INTO application_step_checklists ( progress_id, step_document_id, is_checked, checked_at, checked_by, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{progressId}, #{stepDocumentId}, #{checked}, CASE WHEN #{checked} = true THEN now() ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{checked} = true THEN #{actorUserId} ELSE NULL END, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} ) ON CONFLICT (progress_id, step_document_id) DO UPDATE SET is_checked = EXCLUDED.is_checked, checked_at = EXCLUDED.checked_at, checked_by = EXCLUDED.checked_by, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = now()
mapper.update: -- Save receipt fields and move progress to waiting result. UPDATE application_progresses SET receipt_no = #{receiptNo}, receipt_date = #{receiptDate}, status_code = 'WAITING_RESULT', updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{progressId}

-- Save final result fields and received amount without deriving scoring metrics. UPDATE application_progresses SET status_code = #{statusCode}, result_code = #{resultCode}, result_note = #{resultNote}, result_date = #{resultDate}, received_amount = #{receivedAmount}, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{progressId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert non-PII application progress audit log. INSERT INTO audit_logs ( actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
